goal: Integrate unified damage flow from toolkit refactor - use CombatantRegistry and ApplyDamage instead of manual HP calculation
design_decisions: CombatantRegistry holds all combat participants for proper context
ApplyDamage handles traits (vulnerability, resistance, immunity) properly
Character state must be saved after attacks (like ActivateFeature does)
Vulnerability multipliers must appear in AttackResolvedEvent breakdown

changes: Added Monster.GetHitPoints, Monster.GetMaxHitPoints, Monster.ApplyDamage to toolkit (combat.Combatant interface)
Updated ResolveAttack to create CombatantRegistry with attacker and defender
Added gamectx.WithCombatants(ctx, registry) before combat resolution
Replaced manual HP calculation (newHP = goblin.HP() - result.TotalDamage) with reading monster.HP() after event-driven damage
Damage now flows through the proper event chain: ResolveAttack -> DamageReceivedEvent -> monster.TakeDamage
sessions.notes: Monster's event handler (onDamageReceived) already applies damage when DamageReceivedEvent is published. The orchestrator now just reads the updated HP instead of recalculating it.

next_steps: Save character state after attack (like ActivateFeature does)
Verify vulnerability multipliers in events via integration tests
Add test scenarios for different class/weapon combos (fighter + mace vs skeleton)
